name: Tabby Cat
author: zhou-jianwen
variant_note: An independent interpretation of the individual brown tabby in request #239, with green almond eyes, a dark forehead M, cream chin and brown paws. Existing cat packages and reference-photo pixels are not reused.
license: Non-commercial use only. Commercial use is prohibited. No rights to the requester-supplied reference photograph are claimed.
description: A softly illustrated green-eyed brown tabby based on the individual cat in request #239, with nine task animation states and sixteen clockwise look directions.
asset_note: The final sprite artwork is independently AI-generated with OpenAI image generation, directed and quality-checked in Codex. The photograph is used as appearance reference only; its background and pixels are not copied into the runtime asset.
reference_note: The reference photo was supplied through the no-account request form in Issue #239. The photographer, cat owner, and reference license are not identified; this submission does not invent those attributions. This contribution provides a Codex v2 sprite asset, while desktop window, mouse, and menu behavior depends on the host application.
